review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Proceed with bounded same-turn correction and producer fences
review.notes: Reviewed against exact same-SID completed-turn false-working evidence. The historical writer is unknown. Do not use marker age as completion. Share existing bounded metadata parsing; require exact turn/current verified frontend plus ready nonworking/nonapproval frame for display correction. Do not mutate real markers or fabricate completion. Producer fence only with explicit incoming/current/completion identity; no-ID callbacks remain conservative. Preserve continuation mtime, but refresh actual starts. New tests precede source fix and include deterministic old-code failure; run affected race and core checks. No deployment, restart or private state migration.

cases.description: Read bounded Codex lifecycle metadata with turn identity while preserving legacy boundary callers.
cases.setup: Synthetic HOME/CODEX_HOME, rollout JSONL, marker timestamps and verified-frontend adapter; real production parser/gather/hook entry points. No real pane/state/body collection or timing sleeps.
cases.action: Read complete/abort/start records, append a next start within the same path scope, exercise missing IDs, malformed/oversized tails and equally dated conflicting files.
cases.expected: Return the latest kind, time and explicit turn ID; tied conflicting metadata is unusable as exact completion proof. Legacy kind/time callers still work and scoped facts stay fresh.
surfaces: Shared Go status for CLI, Mac, Web and mobile
